pli-tv-bi-vb-np3:1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np3:1.2: tena kho pana samayena thullanandā bhikkhunī aññatarāya bhikkhuniyā saddhiṃ cīvaraṃ parivaṭṭetvā paribhuñjati.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np3:1.3: athakho sā bhikkhunī taṃ cīvaraṃ saṅgharitvā nikkhipi.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np3:1.5: yante ayye mayā saddhiṃ cīvaraṃ parivaṭṭitaṃ kahaṃ taṃ cīvaranti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np3:1.6: athakho sā bhikkhunī taṃ cīvaraṃ nīharitvā thullanandāya bhikkhuniyā dassesi.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np3:1.8: handayye tuyhaṃ cīvaraṃ āhara me taṃ cīvaraṃ yaṃ tuyhaṃ tuyhamevetaṃ yaṃ mayhaṃ mayhamevetaṃ āhara metaṃ sakaṃ paccāharāti acchindi.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np3:1.9: athakho sā bhikkhunī bhikkhunīnaṃ etamatthaṃ ārocesi.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np3:1.10: yā tā bhikkhuniyo appicchā …pe… tā ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti
pli-tv-bi-vb-np3:1.11: kathaṃ hi nāma ayyā thullanandā bhikkhuniyā saddhiṃ cīvaraṃ parivaṭṭetvā acchindissatīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np3:1.12: athakho tā bhikkhuniyo bhikkhūnaṃ etamatthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np3:1.14: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave thullanandā bhikkhunī bhikkhuniyā saddhiṃ cīvaraṃ parivaṭṭetvā acchindatīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np3:1.17: hi nāma bhikkhave thullanandā bhikkhunī bhikkhuniyā saddhiṃ cīvaraṃ parivaṭṭetvā acchindissati
pli-tv-bi-vb-np3:1.19: evañca pana bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddisantu
pli-tv-bi-vb-np3:1.20.1: yā pana bhikkhunī bhikkhuniyā saddhiṃ cīvaraṃ parivaṭṭetvā sā pacchā evaṃ vadeyya handayye tuyhaṃ cīvaraṃ āhara metaṃ cīvaraṃ yaṃ tuyhaṃ tuyhamevetaṃ yaṃ mayhaṃ mayhamevetaṃ āhara metaṃ sakaṃ paccāharāti acchindeyya vā acchindāpeyya vā nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyanti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np3:2.1.8: channaṃ cīvarānaṃ aññataraṃ cīvaraṃ vikappanupagaṃ pacchimaṃ.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np3:2.1.10: parittena vā vipulaṃ vipulena vā parittaṃ parivaṭṭetvā.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np3:2.1.15: sakiṃ āṇattā bahukaṃpi acchindati nissaggiyaṃ hoti
pli-tv-bi-vb-np3:2.1.16: nissajjitabbaṃ saṅghassa vā gaṇassa vā ekabhikkhuniyā vā.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np3:2.1.19: idaṃ me ayye cīvaraṃ bhikkhuniyā saddhiṃ parivaṭṭetvā acchinnaṃ nissaggiyaṃ imāhaṃ saṅghassa nissajjāmīti …pe…
pli-tv-bi-vb-np3:2.2.1: upasampannāya upasampannasaññā cīvaraṃ parivaṭṭetvā acchindati vā acchindāpeti vā nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np3:2.2.2: upasampannāya vematikā cīvaraṃ parivaṭṭetvā acchindati vā acchindāpeti vā nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np3:2.2.3: upasampannāya anupasampannasaññā cīvaraṃ parivaṭṭetvā acchindati vā acchindāpeti vā nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np3:2.2.4: aññaṃ parikkhāraṃ parivaṭṭetvā acchindati vā acchindāpeti vā āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np3:2.2.5: anupasampannāya saddhiṃ cīvaraṃ vā aññaṃ vā parikkhāraṃ parivaṭṭetvā acchindati vā acchindāpeti vā āpatti dukkaṭassa.
